<infobox theme="Other-Media">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="title"></title>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Attribution information</header>
        <data source="author"><label>Author(s)</label><format>{{#ifeq:{{{author|}}}|None||{{{author|}}}}}</format></data>
        <data source="illustrator"><label>Illustrator(s)</label></data>	
        <data source="editor"><label>Editor(s)</label></data>
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Publication information</header>
        <data source="publisher"><label>Publisher</label></data>	
        <data source="release date"><label>Release date</label></data>	
        <data source="pages"><label>Pages</label></data>
        <data source="published in"><label>Published in</label></data>
        <data source="reprinted in"><label>Reprinted in</label></data>
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:MagazineArticle|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.

The following code flags infoboxes that do not have parameters defined.
-->{{#invoke:InfoboxParamCheck|main|image|title|author|editor|illustrator|publisher|release date|pages|published in|ignore=name|optional=unlicensed,reprinted in,no_year_check,is_appearance}}<!--
-->{{#invoke:MediaDateCheck|main|published in|no_year_check={{{no_year_check|}}}|template_name=MagazineArticle|misc={{{unlicensed|}}}|stories=1|unlicensed={{{unlicensed|}}}}}<!--
-->{{#if:{{{is_appearance|}}}|{{AppMediaCat}}|}}<noinclude>[[category:Media infoboxes]]{{Clear}}

===Usage===
Paste the following code into the top of an article, filling all known fields:
<pre><nowiki>{{Top|real}}
{{MagazineArticle
|image=
|title=
|author=
|illustrator=
|editor=
|publisher=
|release date=
|pages=
|published in=
|reprinted in=
}}</nowiki></pre>

{{Interlang
|tr=Şablon:Dergi makalesi
}}
</noinclude>
